statusHistory.note: Near's first editorial column. Operator-commissioned directly in chat ('can the chief editor publish our first editorial column'), so trust: auto per rules.md's trust-gate (operator naming/commissioning something directly is the approval step). Held at status: draft, not active, purely because heroImage is still null pending near-illustrator generation tooling -- see content/photo-requests.md's zombie-listicle-problem entry. English copy, sourcing (thespiritsbusiness.com on Club Soda's Jan 2026 closure, happycow.net on Redemption Bar Shoreditch's closure), and internal linking (Lucky Saint, Ocean Beach Cafe, Ishigaki Jujitsu -- all verified currently open) are otherwise complete and link-density-compliant. Scoped by near-editor with near-seo (differentiation angle: Near verifies currency, most listicles don't) and RADAR-X (real cross-market pattern surfaced this session: Club Soda, The New Bar, Better Sunday, and Redemption Bar all turned out closed while researching sober-curious content in London and SF). Structural home is a collection per schema.ts's own definition of a collection as 'an editorial story' -- collectionMetaSchema requires placeSlugs.min(1), so a column with zero place references isn't structurally supported without a new content type; this column genuinely references three real places, so no new type was needed. Flip to active + dispatch near-translator once the hero image lands.
